$comment: Provenance record for every published portfolio-economics figure. The point of this file is that a reader can tell exactly how strong each number is without having to trust the profile.

model.name: Noaerth portfolio economics
model.provenance_note: Figures were supplied directly by the owner in conversation. They are not the output of any workbook, script or model file present in this repository or anywhere under /Users/matador/startups. A search of the local portfolio for the stated counts and values returned no matching model. They are therefore recorded as owner-provided management estimates, which is a weaker and more accurate claim than 'model output'.

risk_adjusted.haircut_basis: portfolio overlap and correlation between ventures

arithmetic_checks.note: The stated low figure is rounded to the nearest thousand. The exact product is 171,476,250.
The stated base figure is rounded to the nearest thousand. The exact product is 489,932,250.

arithmetic_checks.claim: stage counts sum to registered ventures

limitations: No workbook, script or model file backing these figures exists in this repository or on the local filesystem. The numbers cannot currently be recomputed.
The 25% overlap haircut is applied uniformly to all three scenarios. That is a simplifying assumption, not a measurement: real correlated exposure would differ per venture and per stage.
Venture-level valuation is not additive to parent value. Summing 124 independent venture valuations assumes none of them share costs, customers, staff or liabilities.
Attributable parent NAV is not established. Ownership percentages across the 124 ventures are undocumented, so no figure here can be assigned to the parent entity.
No traction, revenue, comparable-transaction or discount-rate evidence supports the scenario spread.
'Live' and 'Building' are stage labels, not verified operating status.
publication_rule: Every public rendering of these figures must carry all five labels in required_labels. The phrase 'Noaerth is worth $653M' is prohibited; the permitted form is 'Portfolio model: $653.2M gross base scenario, management estimate, unaudited, not attributable parent NAV'.
geometry_rule: Any generated financial graphic must be numerically honest. Bar or area length must be proportional to the stated value on a stated scale. No 3D volume, perspective or shadow may encode magnitude, because perspective exaggerates and would make the low scenario look larger than the base scenario.
